Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a soft texture. Pale lavender eyes with a sleepy, drowsy expression. Apparent age is early twenties with a mature, serene face. Slender build with a soft silhouette. A signature oversized, off-white oversized sweater dress with light blue accents and sheer white stockings. Signature details include a small white hair clip and a constant look of fatigue.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
